comments.P: Wrong-domain paste: thesis is “make-slot desk / boutique shelf”; hierarchy still talks grade/size and secondary SKUs/testimonials. Signature is “Make-slot control”. Full-width interface + imageless + keyboard-first are the only salvageable bits. Pack nouns bolted onto a leather ecommerce skeleton.
comments.Q: Commit desk done right: fixed passage form strip + append-only mono tape; direction as two-state lock is the only structural drama; amber fault-only; Ctrl+Enter; empty/validation/success/offline. Hex tokens, density-8 type scale, honest unknowns. Best grounded and highest would-build for a harbour logging desk.
comments.R: Two-column compose/log cockpit with always-on status strip and amber rationed to warnings. Density-8 / motion-1 / imageless all held; form→save→row hierarchy clean. Solid operational UI; originality lower because split form/log is the expected instrument pattern. Signature is system-channel strong, less subject-unique than direction lock or chalk board.
comments.S: Product Demo + Features + Swiss Minimalism is marketing chrome for a functional logging job. Rubik/Nunito and blue/orange system palette fight shell/panel/amber. Hierarchy is recognition→facts not open form→save→row. Signature slug. Most generic retrieval shell.
comments.T: Movements Board: permanent chalk-entry head strip + dense ruled body + Ctrl+Enter stamp; IN/OUT marks as harbour vernacular. Strongest directional frame without KPI dashboard. Slightly thinner token/type metrics than Q, but signature and composition are more characterful while still density-8 / motion-1 / imageless.
